rule: P-license (#127): per-artifact provenance and license verified before any agent execution

summary.Datalab: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (AIBIRDS framework + Datalab source repo); research evaluation only, no redistribution
summary.EaglesWing: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (standalone repo LICENSE); research evaluation only, no redistribution
summary.PigShooter: MIT (phy-q/benchmark); may be vendored with LICENSE
summary.game_playing_interface: AGPL-3.0-or-later (sciencebirdsframework); run unmodified as an external process (already the transport of every NovPhy engine run since #46); not vendored, not modified
summary.engine: Science Birds Unity project GPL-3.0-or-later (task_template_designer/License/LICENSE); the stock Linux build is byte-identical to phy-q/NovPhy@0da1258 (MIT repo tag); our #104 player is our own build of that project (pre-existing infrastructure, unchanged by #132)

artifacts.name: Datalab
artifacts.origin: Datalab Birds (AIBIRDS champion 2014/2015; Czech Technical University team), source https://gitlab.fit.cvut.cz/spetlrad/angry-birds-ai (last commit c21ae70c 2015-02-09 'License files.'); this JAR was recompiled for the Science Birds interface by the Phy-Q authors (MANIFEST: Main-Class ab.demo.MainEntry, no Built-By; class timestamps 2021-07-13; packages ab.* (AIBIRDS framework), dl.* (Datalab heuristics), external.* (Science Birds client encoder)) [INFERENCE: builder identity from the repo it ships in and the timestamps; the JAR carries no author field]
artifacts.in_jar_license_evidence: no license file for the agent code; only bundled third-party notices (META-INF/LICENSE.txt + NOTICE.txt = Apache-2.0, Apache Commons Codec); bundled libs: Apache Commons, Java-WebSocket, org.json, Jama

upstream_licenses.holder: AIBIRDS basic game-playing software (package `ab.*`): 'Copyright (c) 2014, XiaoYu (Gary) Ge, Stephen Gould, Jochen Renz, Sahan Abeyasinghe, Jim Keys, Andrew Wang, Peng Zhang. All rights reserved. ... licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 Unported' (the header both agent source repos carry)

artifacts.resolution: The phy-q/benchmark MIT tag covers the Phy-Q authors' own code, not the recompiled third-party agent; the only license attached to the Datalab source is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Treated as CC-BY-NC-SA-3.0.
artifacts.permission: non-commercial research evaluation only: run unmodified as a separate process; results (shots, verdicts, aggregate rates) may be published with attribution; the binary is never copied into the repo by #127/#132, never modified, never redistributed

artifacts.name: PigShooter
artifacts.identical_upstream_copy: phy-q/benchmark@514491c sciencebirdsagents/HeuristicAgents/PigShooter.py (byte-identical); our repo's Client/agent_client.py and SBEnvironment/SBEnvironmentWrapper.py differ from upstream (local edits), so the upstream closure is vendored for E1

observations: data_lab_agent_v5.jar and eagle_wings_agent_v6.jar are already tracked in this repository since commit 68480cd0 (2026-06-05, 'prepare to make the env runnable'), i.e. before #127. CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 permits non-commercial sharing with attribution under the same license, but the #127 policy is 'never redistribute'; #132 adds no copy. Whether to keep them tracked is an owner decision outside #132.
The Phy-Q and NovPhy READMEs name the JARs datalab_037_v4_java12.jar / eaglewings_037_v3_java12.jar; the files actually shipped (and used here) are data_lab_agent_v5.jar / eagle_wings_agent_v6.jar.
